Congenital fusion of interphalangeal joints; extra-skeletal manifestations are not shared across the umbrella.

Cutaneous capillary telangiectasia defines disease; cancers are separate predisposition outcomes; caries is nonspecific and intrinsic enamel defects occur in <30%.
Thrombosis directly occupies the carotid artery; cerebral infarction is a separately diagnosed complication, and transient ischemic symptoms do not establish damage.
Umbrella of inherited ornithine or proline metabolic defects; no additional organ injury is established as common across the group.
